what: Part 2, 'Scoring with a resolver': every saved 4B run re-scored by a strict citation resolver (CPU only, no model calls). Tables only, aggregates over items. Descriptive, on development data; not a confirmation.

measures.citations held: item citations held / cited; same denominator in both columns
measures.complete answers: valid answers that cite something and have every citation holding
measures.intervals: 95%, bootstrap over items (10,000 draws, seed 1), runs not resampled, except the table marked POST HOC, which also resamples each arm's runs

resolver: A citation the checker accepts stays accepted. A rejected citation of the item is searched for only in that item: one node holding the quote resolves it to that path; two or more is ambiguous and stays rejected; none stays rejected. A rejected tool citation is searched for only in the tool result its ref names; no search across results or sources.
corrected: 2026-11-12, after review: the node search visits every node (31 citations moved from 'not in item' to 'ambiguous', none changed acceptance); container counts count only dicts and lists; tool identity is name plus all arguments. No score moved. These tables are the corrected ones.
